{{Top|leg}}
A '''particle field''' was designed to screen low-level [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. [[Raflkind Industrials]]' line of [[Radiation Screener]]s generated particle fields to protect their wearers from low levels of radiation.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> Particle fields were also generated by the fusion reaction that occurred when a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] exploded.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
